name: G-Yen Hutong Co., Ltd.
summary: G-Yen Hutong Co., Ltd. oversees a network of various dining establishments throughout Taiwan. Its operations span multiple popular restaurant concepts, including Hutong, Roast Meat Night Food, Taipei Bird's Day, One Magic Ramen, Hu Dong Niu Noodles, and Cape Cape. The firm is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
